metadata.summary: Final slice of job_agent batch 8: structured job requirements (requirements.py), retrieval plan + rank/dedup/compact (retrieval.py), and the semantic mapping refinement layer (semantic_mapping.py). Cross-file depends_on/calls grounded in verified imports.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/requirements.py
nodes.description: Structured job requirements: a semantic view over a raw posting. extract_job_attributes is deterministic, uses only stored normalized job fields, never calls a model; raw JD text is reduced to a small typed surface so downstream steps never copy it as instructions.

nodes.name: StructuredJobAttributes
nodes.description: Typed, bounded semantic view of a posting used by fit reasoning.

nodes.name: _family_and_track
nodes.description: Role family + track inference from title keywords.

nodes.name: _seniority
nodes.description: Seniority level from combined title+text keyword ladder.

nodes.name: _requirements_concepts
nodes.description: Capability concepts matched from the text, bounded at MAX_CONCEPTS.

nodes.name: _product_scope
nodes.description: 0-10 product-scope score from keyword hits.

nodes.name: _technical_depth
nodes.description: 0-10 technical-depth score from keyword hits.

nodes.name: _organizational_scope
nodes.description: 0-10 organizational-scope score from keyword hits.

nodes.name: _innovation_signal
nodes.description: 0-10 innovation signal from keyword hits.

nodes.name: extract_job_attributes
nodes.description: Build the typed requirement surface for a stored job. Pure and local.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/retrieval.py
nodes.description: Retrieval plan + rank / dedup / compact for career evidence. Queries are templates over structured concepts, never raw JD text; ranker dedupes and promotes by trust; compaction bounds the result for the fit calculator and optional LLM narrative.

nodes.name: build_retrieval_plan
nodes.description: Bounded, deterministic queries from structured attributes; never raw JD text.

nodes.name: concept_coverage
nodes.description: Group evidence by which concepts they support, deterministic, capped per concept.

nodes.name: collect_evidence
nodes.description: Merge profile evidence with memory/corpus retrieval, rank, and cap.

nodes.name: compact_evidence
nodes.description: Bounded safe payload for LLM/log: compact provenance/categorical fields, char-budgeted claim text.

nodes.name: job_agent/job_agent/career/semantic_mapping.py
nodes.description: Semantic requirement mapping: bounded LLM refinement over the deterministic mapping floor. Refinements are subject to hard mechanical constraints: allow-listed evidence required for positive verdicts, negative evidence never upgraded, no downgrades, parse errors degrade to skipped.

nodes.name: SemanticRequirement
nodes.description: One proposed semantic refinement: requirement, coverage, confidence, evidence ids, reasoning.

nodes.name: SemanticMapping
nodes.description: Validated batch of semantic refinements from the model.

nodes.name: SemanticMappingClient
nodes.description: Protocol for any mapping-classification backend.

nodes.name: SemanticMapResult
nodes.description: Result of a refinement attempt: final mapping, applied flag, skipped reason.

nodes.name: parse_semantic_mapping
nodes.description: Parse + validate model output, dropping out-of-allowlist ids; positive verdicts without allow-listed evidence are dropped.

nodes.name: _overlap_score
nodes.description: Rank evidence for a concept window by term overlap + token-level bonus.

nodes.name: _evidence_windows
nodes.description: Bounded per-capability evidence window (referenced 2 + ranked pool).

nodes.name: _compact_evidence
nodes.description: Compact evidence dicts for the model payload.

nodes.name: refine_mapping
nodes.description: Refine the deterministic mapping with semantic proposals (or keep it). Provider-neutral; any failure returns the untouched floor with a skipped reason.

nodes.name: _merge
nodes.description: Apply accepted semantic proposals to the deterministic mapping; accepted refinements get layer=semantic and reasoning.

nodes.name: is_proposal_applicable
nodes.description: Whether a semantic proposal may replace a deterministic verdict: no negative-evidence upgrades, never downgrades coverage, positive verdicts must cite evidence.

nodes.name: advanced_or_reevidenced
nodes.description: True if any coverage upgraded, or any mapping changed evidence set or reasoning.
